name: Glacier Aminos
legalEntity: Glacier Aminos LLC (named in the terms); no address found on the pages read
coaAccess: COA search by batch number (glacieraminos.shop/coas/); no reports listed without a batch number
dispatchInfo: Terms: shipped within 1-2 business days, same day before 2:00 PM Mountain Time Mon-Sat; standard 3-5 days $14, next day $49; US, Puerto Rico and US Virgin Islands; international shipping not available

subscore_reasons.labVerification: Reports are only found by entering a batch number from a vial in the COA search; product pages show no report, lab name or key.
subscore_reasons.fillAccuracy: No report opened, so no measured mg to compare with the label.
subscore_reasons.panelDepth: No test panel could be read without a batch number.
subscore_reasons.entityTransparency: Glacier Aminos LLC is named in the terms; no address or state of registration found; contact by form and e-mail.
subscore_reasons.dispatchReliability: Written shipping terms with cut-off time, carriers options and prices; US territories only.
subscore_reasons.valuePerMg: Ipamorelin $5.20/mg and KPV $4.60/mg (10 mg vials) are around the market middle; GLA-coded products are not counted because the shop does not name the compound.

strengths: Clear written shipping terms with cut-off time
weaknesses: No lab report can be opened without a batch number from a vial
Products sold under code names (GLA-1 SM, GLA-2 TRZ, GLA-3 RT) without naming the compound
verdict: Glacier Aminos names Glacier Aminos LLC and has clear shipping terms, but its lab reports can only be found with a batch number from a vial, so we could not open any. Several products are sold under code names without naming the compound.
summary: US shop (Glacier Aminos LLC) with about 170 listings incl. multi-packs, products sold under code names (GLA-1 SM, GLA-2 TRZ, GLA-3 RT) and a batch-number COA search; US shipping only.
notes: glacieraminos.com redirects to glacieraminos.shop. Prices from the public WooCommerce Store API (GET); multi-packs, strips, sprays and capsules excluded. The product pages do not state which compound GLA-1 SM, GLA-2 TRZ and GLA-3 RT contain; so they are not included in our price comparisons. A search result on glacieraminosus.com (a different domain, blocked for us) describes "GLA-3 RT retatrutide"; not used as a source.
